name: Charlotte Blanche
original_name: シャルロット＝ブランシュ
source:
She is a transfer student from France.  On the outside, she looks like an adorable Lolita, but on the inside, she is a black-hearted girl with a sharp tongue who has some pretty nasty ideas.

She is fussy about money.  She seems to have a long history of rivalry with Aeka, and she is unilaterally considering Aeka as her rival. 

[From [url=https://palette.clearrave.co.jp/product/steal/syaru1.html]official site[/url]]
